About Me

I'm an AI Engineer transitioning into a PhD in generative AI for drug development. I work on combining mechanistic pharmacology models with molecular graph generation, integrating scientific reasoning through LLMs, reinforcement learning, and symbolic verification.

Highlighted Projects

  • LLMs for Mechanistic Model Synthesis: Building models capable of translating scientific text into executable systems of differential equations.
  • Graph-Based Molecular Generation: Flow matching & diffusion models to explore chemical space under biochemical constraints.
  • SOM Clustering for Retail Demand: Shape-based time series clustering using DTW + DBA.
